# Filmora by Wondershare

> > Professional AI-powered video editing software for desktop and mobile platforms with advanced creative tools and automated features.

Filmora is Wondershare's flagship video editing suite offering cross-platform solutions for Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Android. The platform combines professional editing capabilities with AI-driven automation, making video creation accessible to both beginners and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Video Editing
- AI Features
- Text Animation
- Audio Editing
- Video Effects
- Auto-Sync
- Keyframe Animation
- Creative Tools
- Mobile Editing
- Timeline Editor
- Multi-Platform Support
- Auto Beat Sync
- Silence Detection
- Planar Tracking
